items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: this guy Frank Drake that wrote some of this stuff, recorded us.

ctx.x: Yes. 13th and Lydia, and I wrote a tune and called it '13th and Lydia,' and when Booker Pittman came from South America later we recorded that for Columbia. I don't know whether they ever put it out, but this guy Frank Drake that wrote some of this stuff, recorded us.

Anyway, we went into this apartment, and we took this money, and we paid for the apartment. We didn't even have no sheets, no -- you know, nothing. We all crowded in this apartment, went out to the store and brought up a lot of cheese and crackers and everything, so we could make it, but really we didn't have nothing, you know. We were just there, and we tried to proceed to get work.
